summary: First-iteration full-stack testing of VEDED + BookStream. Ran 25 pytest tests covering health, auth (signup/login/me/dup/invalid), VEDED generate (image/video/audio + insufficient credits), creations list/delete, BookStream content/detail/languages/dub-402/trial(first-ok, second-blocked), plans, Stripe checkout (free rejected, unknown rejected, valid returns URL), and payment status 404. All 25 passed. Ran Playwright end-to-end: Landing -> Signup -> Dashboard hero -> Images generate (deducts credit, gallery updates) -> Video generate -> Audio generate -> Movies paywall -> BookStream grid -> BookStreamDetail with trial + dub 402 error toast -> Pricing tab switching (VEDED/BookStream/Top-Ups) -> Payment cancel page -> Login. All flows worked; no console errors other than expected 402 on dub with 0 credits.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: JWT_SECRET falls back to a dev secret if env missing; consider requiring it explicitly in prod.
routes_veded.py: audio cost uses max(len(prompt), 500) which can silently over-charge for long prompts; consider documenting this in UI.
routes_payments.py: STRIPE_API_KEY default 'sk_test_emergent' hardcoded fallback in code; acceptable for preview but risky if leaked to prod.
server.py CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject; not currently an issue because token auth is header-based but should be tightened.

routes_bookstream.trial checks device_fingerprint conflict only when trial_used=True on other user; a user could reuse trial across accounts if they hit before any account with same fingerprint had trial_used flag set (edge case).
test_credentials: Fresh signup users created per run (ftest_*@veded.io / password123). Default seed artist@veded.io/password123 not pre-created; signup on demand works.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py covers all 20+ endpoints and can be reused. Playwright E2E flows all pass. Emergent image gen falls back to Unsplash placeholder — confirmed placeholder loads and gallery renders. Movies studio paywall present via [data-testid=movies-upgrade]. Bookstream detail testids: bs-trial, bs-dub-btn, bs-lang-select. Pricing tabs: tab-veded/tab-bookstream/tab-topups. No blocking bugs found.
